name: Basic Vinaigrette
description: The everyday salad dressing: shake it up in a jar in two minutes, and it keeps for a week.

ingredients.note: red wine, white wine, sherry or cider

instructions: Put the vinegar, mustard, shallot and salt in a jar and let it sit for 5 minutes; the vinegar mellows the shallot.
Add the olive oil and a few grinds of pepper, close the jar and shake hard until thick and combined.
Taste on a leaf of the salad and adjust: more salt if it tastes flat, more oil if it's too sharp.
